rationale: Price is at 87.7% of today's range and within 0.48% of the session high after a sharp gap-up and rapid intraday rally, offering poor risk/reward for a long entry at extended levels. A short against the trend with momentum still pushing higher and price well above VWAP ($38.86) and 9-EMA ($38.53) carries equal risk of continuation. The wide spread (37.9 bps) and lack of a clear consolidation or reversal signal at this early stage of the session make the setup insufficiently defined to commit capital in either direction.
